description: This file contains unit tests for the HibernateProviderDAO class, specifically testing the behavior of the getProvidersByPerson method with respect to including or excluding retired providers.

classes.name: HibernateProviderDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for HibernateProviderDAO focusing on provider retrieval logic.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes the ProviderService and PersonDAO instances and loads initial dataset before each test.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldNotReturnRetiredProvidersIfIncludeRetiredFalse
methods.description: Verifies that retired providers are excluded when includeRetired is false.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldListRetiredProvidersAtTheEnd
methods.description: Verifies that when includeRetired is true, retired providers are present and are last in the list.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldReturnAllProvidersIfIncludeRetiredTrue
methods.description: Checks that all providers are returned when includeRetired is true.
